Use the pilot for community management, research, contributor identification and agreed institutional relationship development.
Store only fields necessary for those purposes; do not add private or sensitive material merely because it can be found.
AI may assist with sorting and drafting, but identity, expertise, sensitivity and publication decisions require a person.
LinkedIn followers are analysed through official aggregate Page exports; they are not reconstructed as a name-level member list.
A public profile can support verification, but publication of a member profile, interview or case study requires an appropriate permission process.
Operational wartime cases may contain information that should not be recorded, shared or published. Apply a separate security review.
Record verification dates, correct inaccurate data and provide a process to archive or remove records when appropriate.
